name: escalate-my
description: Escalate MY™ — Crisis Intelligence Platform for Malaysian Organisations

scripts.db:list: pnpm exec wrangler d1 migrations list escalate-my-db --remote --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:local: pnpm exec wrangler d1 migrations apply escalate-my-db --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: pnpm exec wrangler d1 migrations apply escalate-my-db --remote --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:tables: pnpm exec wrangler d1 execute escalate-my-db --remote --config wrangler.jsonc --command "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name;"
